rows.summary: The Résumé tab's structure actions run on the real components and store in the gate: Add Section (a new section goes last, open, with its first entry; the picker closes), renaming in the title box, the eye (hide, then show), ⋯ → Delete section (the confirm names the section and counts its entries; Cancel keeps it), an entry's Add and Delete (an untouched entry goes without asking), and reordering sections and entries by a drop (through the tab's and the section's own onDragEnd) and by the keyboard (dnd-kit's own KeyboardSensor: Space, the arrow keys, Space or Escape). Each result is checked in the store, on the tab and in the printed PDF. The tests found a real bug: a section let go over nothing threw on over.id and the tab went down. **Now:** it stays where it was (c1f085d, proven fail-first on CI).

The node gate now tests the real Dashboard and ResumeCards over the real store and router. New Résumé covers Start from Scratch, a role starter and New Cover; each opens the right route. Copy gives '<name> (Copy)' as a deep copy with a new id, without `keep`. Inline rename: Enter, Escape, a blank name, the same name, Save name and blur. Delete: the exact confirm, Cancel keeps the résumé, OK removes it and records deletedIds/deletedInfo for the sync; deleting every résumé leaves the empty dashboard. Import: a CPWT-CV backup (fresh id, file's keep ignored), a JSON Resume file (converted) and invalid files (the error shown, nothing imported). A demo account's Keep / Stop keeping / last-original Delete lock and ImportMenu are covered too. Each test would catch a regression in placement, ids, deep copy, the saved state, the confirm wording or the deletion record.

The editor half is covered. For each of the 11 section types, on Classic and on the Sidebar's two columns: hidden, it drops out of the PDF, Word, Markdown, ATS text and JSON Resume, heading included; a hidden section prints exactly what a deleted one prints; with every entry hidden no heading prints; shown again, every export matches the original. MonthPicker writes 'Apr', then 'Apr 2019' (either order); a stored '05/2023' with a new year picked becomes 'May 2024'; × clears the date. Picked dates print in every export and date format. 'Currently working here' writes endDate '' and every export prints Present, even when an imported entry has a leftover end date. The Sidebar's Single · ATS-safe layout prints every section in one column in stored order in the PDF and Word, while two columns split the six side types (SIDEBAR_COLUMN_TYPES / inSidebarColumn pinned). The Word export centres sections as Alignment says in Single, and only the main-column sections in two columns.
rows.remaining: 96-sidebar-single-column checks Section Options → Alignment in Single mode only in Word, not in the PDF (the reviewer's note).

issues: No defects found. Minor: 96-sidebar-single-column's header comment mentions alignment in Single mode, but only Word asserts it (no PDF alignment assertion); 96-structure-keyboard's layOut leaves fake-window props set (a fresh window per mount, so nothing leaks).

notes: Final head f61af54: CI run 36088757851 is green (258 tests across the six 96-* files plus 40-structure, 88-new-section-open, 30-date-editor and 10-section-options; failfirst c1f085d passed; lint passed). Earlier green runs: 36088006903 (R2-158 + failfirst) and 36088467397 (R2-171). The only src/ change is src/components/EditorResumeTab.jsx handleSectionDragEnd (an early return when over is null or is the section itself, as SectionEditor.handleItemDragEnd already does). Observed, not changed: duplicateResume gives the copy a new résumé id but keeps its section and entry ids (Cypress expects the sections to deep-equal the source's), and it reads appState from the render closure rather than from prev, so two duplicates in one tick would both start from the older list. Deferred a11y: a current entry's End Date picker is disabled only by CSS (pointer-events-none, SectionEditorShared.jsx:62), so its selects can still be changed from the keyboard and leave a stale endDate under current:true (the exports ignore it and print Present). New shared test helper: tests/pdf/resume-tab.mjs (the Résumé tab over the real store, with a drop that ends in the DndContext's own onDragEnd).
